verdict.rationale: PostHog documents an official, free hosted MCP server at https://mcp.posthog.com/mcp that works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Windsurf, Zed and others. The docs cover 953 tools across 65 product categories, a context-saving CLI mode, per-session tool scoping, Streamable HTTP transport, one-command install via the wizard and an official AI plugin. A live probe confirms the endpoint is OAuth-gated per the MCP authorization spec, with granular read/write scopes. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on reports of agents completing real tool calls end-to-end, since the probe only verifies the auth handshake and metadata.
